payload.reason: The evidence provides clear demonstrations of the interpretability merits of the approach through empirical results and the involvement of crowd workers in generating keyword-specific expectations.

claims.text: The approach improves model interpretability by providing human-understandable explanations through keyword-specific expectations obtained from crowd workers.
Empirical results show that the approach enhances accuracy and interpretability, improving state-of-the-art performance by 24.3%.
The iterative process of leveraging crowd input for keyword discovery allows for insights into model learning, enhancing interpretability.
